story: Real-time personalization. Banco Falabella's Benefits agent already exists but answers 'what benefits do I have this month?' the same way for everyone. This demo shows the same agent giving a materially better, personalized answer once Snowplow Signals feeds it real-time behavior (pages just browsed), synced predictive scores (Bandit ranking, CMR tier), and session memory — then proactively nudging the customer via an intervention before they even ask. The demo must open on the agent answering better, not on a pipeline diagram.
narrativeBeats: Control: ask the benefits question with Signals off -> generic, unranked list
Treatment: browse Viajes category, view TurBus + Lipigas -> ask same question -> agent leads with travel/gas, cites Bandit rank + CMR tier, shows injected context narrative block
Proactive: keep browsing travel -> intervention fires -> in-flow orb nudge appears unprompted
Under the hood: Snowplow Console — attribute groups, warehouse sync, service, agentic context prompt edit -> republish -> live behavior change, no code deploy
Governance: Event Studio schema, BigQuery atomic.events + failed events, agent tool-calls landing as audit-trail events

pages.name: Ahorro/Cuenta
pages.description: Simple savings/account overview page — exists mainly to round out the app and fire product_page_viewed.

pages.name: Asistente (chat sidebar)

pages.description: The Benefits agent chat. This is the centerpiece of the demo — must visibly show the injected Signals context narrative when Signals is toggled on, and support a visible Signals ON/OFF toggle for the control-vs-treatment beat.
features: Signals ON/OFF toggle for live A/B demo
Injected context narrative block shown expandable under agent replies
